name: Berghof Thöni
beschreibung: The Berghof Thöni is located in the midst of the mountain landscape of Tirol and combines traditional ambience with cozy comfort. As an inn, the house offers a kitchen with regional cuisine, where seasonal specialties and local products are prepared. Guest rooms are practically furnished and invite you to relax after hikes or ski tours. The location is well suited for excursions into the surrounding nature, whether in summer or winter. Family hospitality and a casual atmosphere characterize the stay.
